configuration.actual_calls_policy: use per-repeat physical calls; preserves TMC truncation
configuration.baseline_favouring_caveat: Displayed baselines other than S-Diff are assigned zero nonutility overhead, conservatively favouring them. S-Diff is charged a full-pipeline wall-time upper bound, which is conservative against S-Diff.
charged_extra_time_components: S-Diff source complete 128-process pipeline wall time as a conservative upper-bound surcharge

omitted_source_method.reason: OFA is represented by the requested ratio estimator

configuration.sdiff_surcharge_caveat: The source did not separately time S-Diff coalition generation, its O(n^3) stratified pair state, inter-process merging, and reconstruction. Its complete persistent-128-process estimator wall time is therefore added as an upper-bound surcharge. That wall time includes some utility evaluation and hence slightly double-counts utility work.
configuration.time_formula: actual_utility_calls * median_scalar_utility_seconds + I[method=INSIDE-Greedy] * measured_design_seconds + I[method=S-Diff] * source_complete_parallel_wall_seconds
configuration.utility_cost_caveat: RBF-SVM utility cost depends on coalition composition and size; one common Q*-averaged scalar calibration is used as the requested cross-method proxy, not measured end-to-end time.

game.empty_coalition_rule: best constant-label accuracy on the fixed test set
game.single_class_rule: predict the coalition's sole observed class
